proposal: Make claim evidence checks affect the final meeting record, including acceptance, owner, deadline, retraction, and coverage review.
scope: Public AMI meetings IN1005, IN1007, IN1009; 26 existing action and decision cards from two generated package arms; same cards and draft transcripts for every check.
label_provenance: Prior blind Gemini 3.8 Flash audit against human AMI transcript windows around cited ASR times. These are model labels, not human gold judgments.

existing_cited_only_opt_in.interpretation: Flags every claim; it has no useful selective coverage on this set.

existing_expanded_review.interpretation: All cards are provisional; this is a human-review queue, not an automatically more accurate final record.

meeting_separated_calibration.method: Search one-score thresholds on IN1005 and IN1009 only, require at least three retained cards, maximize balanced accuracy with precision and recall tie breaks; apply unchanged to IN1007.
meeting_separated_calibration.interpretation: The selected gate provides no gain on the held-out meeting. The split was chosen after score inspection and is exploratory, not blind prospective validation.

not_measured: Recall of actions or decisions omitted entirely by the generator
Human acceptance and correction time for flagged cards
End-to-end final-record accuracy after human review
Live meeting latency and UI impact
